title: Bind delayed-cover batches to recursive allocation and return
body:
The delayed-cover allocation boundary now has an explicit whole-batch address and return map. A fresh row consumes `W=L*H` stock values, but each child retains all H high matrices and has **volume V/L**, not V/W. At depth j the retained batch volume is V/L^j while unused stock is P/(L*H)^j. The resulting active-chain space is below `K*V*L/(L-1) <= 2*K*V` under the stated local machine premise.

The source-bound proof applies to the final fixed compiled template. It preserves ancestor high matrices, complete child stock, arbitrary payloads and return addresses. Parent-dependent weights remain independent of the child's fresh cover. Private banks increase local space without receiving productive credit. The cover, fresh-cylinder counting theorem and fixed-PR589 packet implementations retain predecessor credit; they are not counted as new constructions.

Validation: 186,252 complete all-depth addresses against a separate coordinate-product oracle; literal nested arbitrary-label descent/return; all 7,776 two-role GL2(Z/9Z) cover rows; 31,104 route/spectator checks; ancestor-weight and exact geometric checks; seven rejection controls. Registered Python3.12, committed-byte/mode, source-corruption and read-only Git-free optimized replay pass. Full-history preflight was not run in the shallow checkout. Hosted CI and independent review remain pending.

This closes a conditional geometry implication named by PR5814. It is a reference address model, not a physical dispatcher. Old atom-interchange, routing/fallback local space, generated descriptor evaluation, numerical children and private return remain implementation obligations. All five project assumptions retain their status. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5009#discussioncomment-19209412). PR5814 source: `68614094a31bd483083cfaf1f8735ceb6aec5224`. Credit Mason Hale, Nick Petalas, Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, Cinna Davis, David Arias, zxv and all retained BIT/compiler/cover sources. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

CI dependency: unchanged PR5761 test-only repair `ba8a9e640e1983f3c29993fefa3f46e8ed03313a`, cherry-picked with original authorship and provenance. No research artifact or selected claim is changed by that repair.
